scope: Regression checks run after prod audit turned green. Each check has command, exit code, and verdict. Pre-existing failures unrelated to the security batch are recorded with reproduction evidence (HEAD reproduce) so they are not falsely attributed.

checks.name: pnpm --filter api exec npx prisma validate
pnpm --filter api build
checks.regressionScope: API nest build still passes; Prisma Client v7.9.1 regenerated into apps/api.

checks.name: pnpm test:contracts
checks.details: 187 tests, 184 pass, 3 fail. The 3 failures are in bridge-eligibility.test.ts: (a) 'bridge eligibility keeps standalone forms and unsupported target scopes out' — STANDALONE_RUNTIME_TEMPLATE vs null; (b) 'generated roster is unique, sorted, and free of duplicates/canaries' — 290 !== 213; (c) 'every entry has a non-empty evidencePath and evidenceSha256' — BM-025 evidenceSha256 mismatch. Identical output (184 pass / 3 fail) reproduced on HEAD before this batch's manifest changes, confirming these failures are pre-existing Phase 13/14 curation fallout and are NOT caused by the security batch. They are out of scope for the security commit and will be addressed by a later Phase 15 workstream.

checks.name: pnpm test:api
checks.details: 752 tests, 751 pass, 1 fail. Single failure: docx-slot-inventory.spec.ts compares a hard-coded inputDigest sha256 against a freshly computed one; expected b5bab6… received 3f13ef… This is the same SHA-tracked test that was last refreshed by commit 79fe4262 'test(api): refresh docx slot inventory gate'. The failure is an input-bytes drift gate, not a behavioural regression. Not caused by security batch.

checks.name: pnpm test:node
checks.details: 2215 tests, 2132 pass, 82 fail. Failing suites cluster around runtimeReady allowlist, BM-001/BM-171 smart runtime UX, BM-125/126/129/130/136 family curation, and BM-002/BM-003/BM-004/BM-005 semantic profiles. None of these suites reference @hono/node-server, valibot, body-parser, or brace-expansion. They reproduce identically before and after the security batch and are out of scope here.

checks.name: pnpm test:web-unit
checks.details: 1475 tests, 1458 pass, 17 fail. Failures cluster around template chooser hardcoded text-white action class, BM-001/BM-171 runtime UX guards, BM-069 curated profile, and FormFlight runtimeReady allowlist matching canonical 11-form roster. None reference the security-batch dependency changes. Pre-existing and out of scope.

checks.name: pnpm audit:forms:corpus
checks.details: Form documents 214, reference excluded 2, unique template codes 213, locked contracts 213, draft contracts 214, duplicate codes 1 (pre-existing). corpusForms=213, formsMissing=0.

checks.details: Trailing whitespace warnings all originate in storage/bootstrap-artifacts/bootstrap.latest.sql, which is a transient bootstrap artifact (not source, not committed by this batch).
